title: Play: Embrace the Wisdom of Your Inner Child
coreMove: Use playful exploration to loosen a narrowed mind so better options can appear.
sourcePressure: The chapter defends play as essential fuel for broader options, lower stress, executive function, and creative exploration.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would reduce play to leisure, reward, or childish fun after the real work is done.

exampleSpecs.domain: prosthetics lab stuck on a painful socket design
exampleSpecs.audience: engineer whose serious work is stuck
exampleSpecs.stakes: playful model-making can reveal a pressure path formal review missed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She uses clay and rubber bands to model the socket and sees the pinch point no spreadsheet showed.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Clay strips lie beside a prosthetic socket mold.

exampleSpecs.domain: floodplain engineers testing a public plaza drainage plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: play simulation can expose water movement before concrete is poured
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: They pour dyed water over a tabletop plaza model and watch the puddle choose the flaw for them.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Dyed water moves across a tabletop plaza model.

exampleSpecs.domain: tax clinic volunteers designing better intake for non-English speakers
exampleSpecs.stakes: playacting the intake can reveal hidden friction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: They swap roles with blank forms and toy counters until a volunteer playing client gets stuck at the same question.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Toy counters sit on translated intake forms.

exampleSpecs.domain: choir director rebuilding rehearsal after voices keep tightening
exampleSpecs.stakes: playful vocal constraints can uncover a freer route to serious sound
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before, she repeats corrections; after, she asks singers to pass a melody like a ball and hears tension drop.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A foam ball rests on a marked choral score.

exampleSpecs.domain: emergency dispatch trainers preparing recruits for ambiguous calls
exampleSpecs.audience: trainers needing flexible judgment under stress
exampleSpecs.stakes: playful scenario cards can expand response options safely
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A bizarre call card makes recruits laugh, then reveals the hidden question they missed in serious drills.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A strange scenario card lies beside a headset.

exampleSpecs.domain: watchmaker diagnosing a recurring escapement fault
exampleSpecs.stakes: miniature play can reveal motion sequence differently
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Paper gears rotate under a desk lamp while the real escapement waits, and the wrong contact point finally becomes visible.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Paper gears turn beneath a brass loupe.
